sourceEvidence.title: Plant Manager Oregon
sourceEvidence.quote:
The Plant Manager's primary mission will be to lead the Plant to consistently deliver low-cost, high-quality products in a safe and environmentally responsible manner. The Plant Manager will have full P&L responsibility and will manage, direct, and lead the Plant operations. They will be a key member of the operational management team, will assist in the organization's vision and growth strategies, and will execute business and operations plans to achieve performance targets. The Plant Manager will have budget responsibility and provide the leadership, direction, and management for all aspects of the plants manufacturing operations.

The Plant Manager will oversee the activities of direct reports in manufacturing operations, engineering, quality, environmental, health and safety, production control and logistics, finance and human resources. In the union manufacturing environment, he/she will optimize resources and be accountable for the performance of safety, service, planning, production, quality, inventory management, capital project implementation, and leadership/organizational effectiveness.
